title: Law to require mobile drinking fountains on hot days
summary: This bill would require the Department of Environmental Protection to run a mobile drinking fountain program each year from June 15 to September 15, deploying fountains when temperatures are forecast to hit 82 degrees or higher. The department would need at least two fountains per Council district, with priority given to neighborhoods with high heat vulnerability, and must post an online schedule of deployment locations and times. The law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
